recognize_zh: 頭顱正面 X 光片可見顱骨布滿大小不一、邊緣清楚、無硬化邊的圓形透亮區（punched-out lytic lesions），是漿細胞腫瘤侵犯骨骼的典型影像。
features: Innumerable round, well-demarcated lucent (lytic) lesions throughout the calvarium
Lesions vary in size and lack sclerotic margins ('punched-out')
No periosteal reaction evident; facial bones relatively spared
describe_en: Frontal skull radiograph shows innumerable round, sharply marginated lytic lesions of varying size throughout the calvarium without sclerotic rims or periosteal reaction, the so-called 'punched-out' pattern. This is a radiologic, not morphologic, image. The pattern is characteristic of osseous involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma or multiple plasmacytomas of bone); calvarial lesions may extend into adjacent soft tissue as extramedullary masses. Tissue diagnosis is required.

ddx.vs: Lytic metastases are usually fewer, more irregular, and may have ill-defined margins or mixed sclerosis; biopsy shows keratin-positive carcinoma.
LCH gives beveled-edge ('hole-within-hole') lytic lesions, usually fewer and in younger patients, with CD1a-positive cells on biopsy.
Hyperparathyroidism produces tiny diffuse granular lucencies rather than discrete punched-out lesions, with elevated PTH and calcium.
